steps.text: Preheat a Belgium waffle iron. Whisk together the flour, baking soda, baking powder, white sugar, and salt in a bowl; set aside.

Whisk together the eggs, 1 1/2 teaspoons vanilla extract, and milk in a bowl. Stir in the melted butter and flour mixture until a slightly lumpy batter forms. Cook the waffles in the preheated iron until steam stops coming out of the seam, about 2 minutes.

Meanwhile, melt 1/4 cup of butter in a saucepan over medium heat. Stir in the brown sugar, rum extract, 2 teaspoons vanilla extract, and cinnamon. Bring to a simmer, the stir in the pecans and continue simmering for 1 minute. Stir in the pancake syrup and bananas, continue cooking until the bananas soften, about 4 minutes.
Beat the heavy cream, 1/4 teaspoon of vanilla and confectioners' sugar with an electric mixer in a medium bowl until firm peaks form.
Once waffles are done, spoon bananas Foster sauce over waffle and top with a dollop of whip cream.

raw_recipe.headline: Bananas Foster Belgian Waffles
raw_recipe.description: As a special treat for my mother, I created this recipe, which includes one of her favorite desserts and one of her favorite breakfast items. The banana topping is also great on French toast.

video.description: Everyone loves waffles, so make terrific Belgian-style waffles with a batter of flour, baking soda, baking powder, sugar, salt, eggs, vanilla, milk and melted butter. Cook up the batter in an iron, then make an extra special sauce of butter, brown sugar, rum extract, vanilla and cinnamon. Stir in pecans, pancake syrup and bananas and simmer until softened. Prepare a special whipped topping from heavy cream, vanilla and confectioners’ sugar. Assemble these decadent waffles with plenty of bananas foster sauce and big, fluffy clouds of sweet whipped cream.

review.reviewBody: ABSOLUTELY DELICIOUS!! I followed the recipe as stated except I was out of rum extract so I used double the amount of pure madagascar vanilla extract. These waffles were so tasty! I will replace my regular waffle recipe with this one. For the pancake syrup used in this, I used the Absolute Best Pancake Syrup recipe (love) from this site. Thanks, Prell2k4 for a great recipe!

Love this recipe, even if you don’t use the syrup portion it’s still a great waffle and can be made in smaller quantities easily. For the syrup I did make some changes- instead of using extract I used real rum (cause why not lol) and also real maple syrup. Penzy spices makes a “pie spice” combination that I also used 1/4 teaspoon of in the syrup. It all turned out amazing.

I only used the banana foster part of the recipe and used Kraken Black spiced rum. I also didn’t have brown sugar so I used golden sugar and a bit of molasses. This was a hit with my family! Definitely going to make this again!! Thanks so much for sharing this delicious recipe!

I tried this reciepe for my Bed and Breakfast and would make a few changes. I would not put the pecans in the sauce, I think it would be better to chop and toast the pecans, then sprinkle on top. I would also reduce the rum extract to 1 tsp. I agree with another review regarding the waffle, a bit to eggie... I think once tweeked a bit, this receipe would make it to my bed and breakfast table.

Very good recipe. I am not a big fan of rum, so no extract for me. To lessen the sweetness next time I will omit the syrup. I also thing toasting the pecans slightly brings out some more flavor.One thing that I will add next time is a scoop of vanilla ice cream ontop of the waffle and then the banana mixture. Even though I would make a slight change to the recipe next time, it is still a 5 star breakfast/desert...thanks

I also thing toasting the pecans slightly brings out some more flavor.One thing that I will add next time is a scoop of vanilla ice cream ontop of the waffle and then the banana mixture. I managed to stop eating this long enough to write this review...I wish I could have recorded the look on my hubby and sons face when they took their first bite, it was priceless! This recipe is a KEEPER! I served this with the banana foster sauce, I had no pecans so I used peanuts which was very yummy with the bananas, and a dollop of home made whipped cream! Very good! Excellent Dessert! 500 million stars for you, thank you for sharing this, I am now hailed queen of the waffles in my house:)

The recipe that came with my waffle maker was terrible, so I tried this one with 2 twists: I substituted buttermilk for the milk and rum for the rum extract. My kids LOVE the waffles and I make them without the sauce, but sometimes add just fresh bananas and whip cream. In my Belgian machine, this recipe barely makes 4, so I usually triple the recipe & freeze the leftovers.

These were so delicious!! I followed the recipe to a "T" except that I didn't cook the pecans and waited to sprinkle them on at the end. Definitely a dessert for breakfast treat, and one that I will make again and again. Thanks so much for a great recipe!
Amazing Recipe! I just used the banana part and left out the rum and pecans then put it over vanilla yogurt. I also added uncooked oatmeal and it was delicious! Thank you!

I think the rum extract measurement may be a bit off, or what I had was really strong because it over powered everything. Probably would have been 5 stars with half the rum extract, but as it all you could taste was the rum extract which smells awful and doesn't taste much better.
It was easy to make, and it tasted just like banana bread. I doubled the sauce so I have extra for other dishes.
Darn good recipe. I think I’ll make the Carmel topping before starting the waffle mix next time. Also think I’ll try without the Rum flavor as well.
I am not so much a waffle fan but this was absolutely delicious. My wife likes waffles and she thoroughly enjoyed this recipe! She definitely will want this again.

This sauce is just amazing. Since I found this recipe last week I have made it for my teenage boys 4 times. We have tried it on pancakes and waffles and can't decide which is better! This is a very simple recipe to make! Thank you!

Followed the recipe! Oh my goodness theses are great waffles. Cook time for me was 3 minutes and the waffle came out awesome! Depending on how sweet you like things be careful with sauce as it is very sweet. This is my go to for waffles from now on! Thanks for the recipe.

Yum! This was so good! The only complaint from the family was that the waffles weren't as crispy as we like them. Will probably use a different waffle recipe and then make this banana sauce to go over them.
